decisions.reason: The double-sided placard wording does not necessarily change the current component-selection or BOM state; any additional placard materials or hardware would require further design or sourcing evidence.
The source changes the placard's display behavior, but it does not change the current system-layout deliverable or its existing dispensing-path constraint.
Displaying identical placard wording on both sides has no entailed effect on the electrical wiring plan or its valve-control coverage.
